record.title: Issuer transfer agent · SEC registration
kv: The activity is an issuer transfer-agent function within the statutory registration perimeter.
Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC (registered or chartered); Computershare Inc. (registered or chartered)
Transfer agents whose covered activities and entity category require registration with the SEC
Confirm the covered security and statutory function. For entities assigned to the SEC, establish effective registration. Separately establish issuer appointment and the authoritative record.
A chain or technology vendor does not inherit its client’s transfer-agent registration.

Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC: The 2026 public-company subsidiary exhibit identifies Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC, and BlackRock's July 2026 BRSRV prospectus appoints that exact entity as transfer agent. Older TA and BUIDL filings use Securitize LLC, establishing the historical name boundary rather than a still-unresolved current entity.
Computershare Inc.: A 2015 Form TA-1/A names Computershare Inc. and checks the SEC as its appropriate regulatory agency.

Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC: SEC-registered transfer-agent entity in existing canonical evidence. Historical Form TA-1 evidence identifies Securitize LLC; current 2026 subsidiary and BlackRock product filings identify Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC and provide a current named appointment.

Computershare Inc.: Transfer-agent registrant with SEC checked as appropriate regulatory agency in filed Form TA-1/A. The 2015 filed Form TA-1/A identifies Computershare Inc., file number 084-05925, and checks SEC as the appropriate regulatory agency.
